topic_title: Cell Biology - The Unit of Life

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, tumhara mobile charge khatam hone par chalta hai?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Nahi sir... battery low ho jaye to band ho jata hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Tab bhi problem... par battery hogi to on to rahega na?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Sahi baat! Mobile ka sabse chhota working part kya hai jo usko actually 'zinda' rakhta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Chip yaani processor - wo sabse chhoti 'working unit' hai. Lekin wo 'alive' nahi hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Tumhare body mein bhi ek sabse chhoti unit hai... par wo ALIVE hai! Saans leti hai, khana khati hai, waste nikalti hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: CELL! Jaise mobile chips se bana hai, waise hi tum CELLS se bane ho! Par farak ye hai - cell LIVING hai! 🧬

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab main cells se bana hoon? Kitni hogi mere mein?
